title: When a monster looks under something
summary: Monsters in R.E.P.O. search as well as chase: one of their states is for looking under things, and it is run on two timers, one for waiting and one for looking.
body: A monster does not only walk at you. The game keeps a state whose whole job is looking under things, which is why one can stop at a shelf and check beneath it rather than walking past.
The state waits first. There is a shortest and a longest wait before anything happens, so the pause before a check is not fixed and cannot be counted on.
Then it looks. There is a shortest and a longest look of its own, which is why the check takes a range of time rather than a single moment.
Between the two there is no animation to read. What tells you the state is running is that the monster has stopped and is looking, which is exactly the moment to stay put rather than move.
What this entry does not tell you: how long the waits and the looks come to in seconds, or what triggers the state. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: One of the monsters' states is for looking under things.
The state waits for between a shortest and a longest time before looking.
The look itself lasts between a shortest and a longest time.

alt.en: Diagram: a monster stops, waits for a while between two limits, then looks under something for a while between two more limits.
alt.zh: 示意图：怪物停下、在两个界限之间等待一段时间，然后在另外两个界限之间朝下方查看一段时间。
